pages.text: Supply heat, water and Shards of Divinity to create Ichor. The stand can recycle supported celestial modules, selected music discs and enchanted books for a 10% chance of a Shard of Divinity.

Heat: lava bucket 10, two magma blocks 1, soul campfire 2, campfire 1. Water: water bucket or two blue ice = 1. One shard supplies 10 catalyst charges. Two heat, one catalyst and one water create 1,000 Ichor.
